name: @oxagen/desktop
description: The Oxagen desktop app: installs the CLI and the Tacho wrapper for Claude Code and Codex, signs a machine in to an org, and lets the operator pick or change the workspace the host reports to. Spec: docs/specs/oxagen-desktop/spec.md.

scripts.bundle:dmg: node scripts/sidecars.mjs && tauri build --bundles app dmg
scripts.lint:rust: node scripts/rig-stubs.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:rig: pnpm --filter @oxagen/tacho exec vitest run src/cli/install-rig.test.ts src/host/install-hardening.test.ts && pnpm run test:rust
